The man in the green jacket appears to conceal an item after interacting with the other person near the display case; he then repeatedly adjusts his jacket and pockets while moving toward the center of the store, exhibiting classic shoplifting behavior (concealment and nervous checking). The other individual exits quickly, possibly acting as a distraction.

His posture and movement—especially turning away quickly after brief observation and heading directly to the exit—suggest possible concealment of an item (a small black box is visible on the table before he moves away). No visible transaction occurs, and his behavior aligns with typical shoplifting patterns: scanning environment, minimal engagement, and rapid exit.

Their posture and repeated glances suggest intent to conceal merchandise, consistent with shoplifting behavior. No visible staff interaction occurs during this segment.
